summary: Describes a mechanism for QUIC clients and servers to select a mutually supported version. When the first flight formats are compatible, negotiation can happen without an extra round trip. It updates the QUIC documents it builds on.

eli5.summary: Two people figure out a language both understand. If they are lucky, they work it out in the first sentence without extra back-and-forth.
